production_kind: Not authorized by this fixture; must be a distinct explicitly selected contract, never silently treat fixture as production.

runtime.start.already_running: May return same started epoch/PID or hold, but must not create another child.

runtime.status.paused: Must reflect actual current owner SQLite pause.

runtime.pause.effect: Persist owner.paused using existing owner/pause semantics; false is explicit resume only.

runtime.stop.effect: Owned local process close/terminate and wait; idempotent stopped observation, no invented shutdown RPC.

read_response_fields: native_id actual stdio request/response id (str/int, not bool)
read_native_ids: Unique across epochs; old/unexpected IDs fail closed, no stale cached success.
restart_definition: runtime.stop then runtime.start in same Broker gives new actual process/instance and new epoch.
pause_restart_definition: Separate test stops owned control Broker after child stopped, starts same owned installation/SQLite in a new Broker process and verifies pause remains; no automatic child start.
